text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Examples

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  regenerate-examples:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --workspace --verbose

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --verbose

      - name: Run database integration tests
        run: just test-db

      - name: Run end-to-end tests
        run: just test-e2e

      - name: Check for clippy warnings
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt -- --check

      - name: Check for code duplication
        run: cargo dupes

      - name: Generate examples
        run: cargo run --bin tokf-filter -- generate-examples

      - name: Generate sandboxed examples
        run: cargo run --bin tokf-filter -- generate-examples-sandboxed

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add tokf-filter/examples.rs tokf-filter/tests/examples.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No changes to commit"; else git commit -m "Regenerate examples with safety checks"; fi

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
```
